Duckware is one icon for your taskbar that opens DuckWriter, Duckument, DuckNotes and DuckSheets. It installs the ones you don't have yet, shows which have updates, lists the documents you opened lately, and can start with Windows.

## Install

1. Download **Duckware-Setup.exe** below. That one file is all you need.
2. Run it. Windows may say "Windows protected your PC", because the installer isn't code-signed. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
3. Right-click Duckware in the Start menu or taskbar and pin it.

It needs Windows 10 or 11. Duckware goes online only to check for updates and to download the apps you install from it.

The "Source code" files below are added by GitHub automatically; you don't need them.
